releases.title: Update
changes: Character movement and expressions in the focus space now feel more natural.
Added focus-space ambience that changes with the time and weather.
In Weather settings, you can now select major cities or search for cities worldwide.
Added language learning features and new voices.
Audio and music previews now let you seek and mute playback directly.
AI model downloads continue as you navigate, with options to view progress or stop them.
Feed generation status is now clearer, and in-progress tasks can be stopped directly.
Background music volume now adjusts naturally when a conversation begins.
Improved usability in fullscreen, screensaver, and desktop modes.
Improved reliability when saving settings and playlists.
Reduced errors during sign-in and session recovery.
Fixed duplicate and playback issues when recovering or retrying feed conversations, albums, and music.
Improved initial loading and the reliability of weather and music data refreshes.
